pending.title: Miniature World
pending.prompt: Shrink the person in the photo into a tiny full-body figure, keeping their face, hair, and skin tone perfectly recognizable and unchanged. Even though the photo is a close-up portrait, imagine and generate their complete body with correct proportions, arms, legs and feet. Place them standing or sitting inside an everyday environment like a [SETTING: desk, cup, or open book]. Use macro photography, a shallow depth of field, warm lighting, and realistic miniature scale illusion. Keep the person's face and identity exactly the same as in the photo, preserving their exact facial structure, hairstyle, hairline, forehead shape, eyebrows, eye shape, nose structure, lips, jawline, skin tone, facial texture and natural appearance exactly as shown. Do not beautify, smooth skin, cartoonize, or replace their face with a different person. Identity preservation is the highest priority.
